findings.title: Git metadata redirects allow unconfined parent traversal
findings.detail: PinnedSource.directory splits metadata redirect paths but does not reject `..`; it opens each component via `/proc/self/fd/<fd>/..`, which traverses to the parent. gitMetadata passes the `.git` file target and `commondir` value directly to this method. A selected checkout can therefore redirect metadata reads outside its selected metadata tree, contrary to the approved no-follow/selected-source isolation. This is an actual gap even though legitimate linked worktrees need a bounded parent-relative redirect.
findings.required_fix: Constrain `.git` and `commondir` redirects to the explicitly supported worktree metadata layout, with a finite validated parent traversal and pinned directory handles; reject all other escapes. Add tests for permitted linked-worktree redirects and redirects escaping to an unrelated directory, including replacement races.

dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: The main source separation, scope, display and unknown-state criteria are implemented and locally tested, but the approved exact-source/no-follow isolation criterion has the concrete redirect traversal gap R57-C1.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: Implemented tasks 1.2, 2.1-2.2, 3.1-3.2 and 4.1-4.2 are represented. Task 1.1 exhaustive-bound/unsupported-layout evidence remains explicitly open; integration task 4.4 is correctly pending prerequisites.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: The source test file includes real temporary Git repositories, packed refs, dirty-checkout and replacement cases, and boundary tests. It does not test rejection/confinement of `..` in `.git`/commondir redirects; Task 1.1's exhaustive bounds/unsupported-layout audit remains pending. Local report states 52 Node, 154 web, 38 runtime and 41 browser tests passed.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: Local full verification is reported passed; hosted CI is explicitly pending, so the configured CI dimension is not complete.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: The metadata redirect traversal finding R57-C1 violates the approved filesystem isolation boundary. No runtime control or operator-token fallback was found in reviewed implementation paths.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: The implementation uses owner-session admission, independent connected-user authority, fixed bounded helper inputs and globally nonqueueing host/GitHub slots as planned. Metadata redirect confinement does not fully meet the approved design.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: README, runtime runbook and architecture documentation were updated. The runbook claims selected metadata/no-follow guarantees more strongly than the current redirect traversal enforces.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: The OpenSpec delta and implementation preserve separate observation sources, repository-scoped joins, unknown health/capacity semantics, read-only behavior and the accepted first-slice scope; no product independence regression was identified.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: Local full verification and a selected-host operator receipt exist. Hosted CI, final Task 1.1 exhaustive-bound audit, stacked #50/#52 prerequisites and actual acting-user administration-read acceptance remain open. The host receipt is not acting-user acceptance.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: This is the independent code-checkpoint review. It does not satisfy final Done review, protected/production gates, merge approval or integration prerequisites.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: The Plan, runbook and receipts explicitly defer capacity/usage/process health, hosted CI, stacked prerequisites, acting-user acceptance and physical-device evidence; no production/full-Done claim is made.
